easyPrerequisites: You have the city's blessing and/or control at least nine permanents.
description:
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator that is a 1/1 Balloon with flying and haste.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Timestream Navigator token will give you the city's blessing.
Activate the Timestream Navigator token by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it onto the bottom of your library from the battlefield, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
